verdict.rationale: Bland's docs cover every piece of the story. There is a 'build your first agent' guide with in-browser talk testing, and prompting via pathways. You can pick a built-in voice or clone one, create inbound numbers or configure them via the CLI, and dispatch live calls. A community user also reports experimenting with building a phone agent on it. missing for 10: evidence that the end-to-end setup to a first live phone call fits within an hour, a documented quickstart step tying a phone number to the first agent, independent hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
